name: Leatherman Wave+ multi-tool
summary: An 18-function folding multi-tool for small repairs and kit maintenance. Match the finish and included accessories, and use suitable tools for electrical or high-load work.
description: A multi-tool can cover small jobs when a full toolbox is not available: opening packaging, trimming cord or adjusting a compatible fastener. The Wave+ combines several implements in a compact frame, but it does not replace correctly sized workshop tools. Choose the functions needed in your kit, practice opening and closing them safely and check the transport rules for its blades.

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: 18 listed tools, including pliers, blades, files and bit drivers

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: 8.5 oz (approximately 241 g), without assuming accessory weight

specs.label: Primary blade
specs.value: 420HC stainless steel; 2.92 inches on the current product page

specs.label: Wire cutters
specs.value: Replaceable wire-cutter inserts; not insulated for energized work

specs.label: Package variation
specs.value: Finish, sheath and additional bits must be checked separately

pros: Several small repair functions share one carrying format.
Replaceable cutter inserts allow a worn component to be serviced.
cons: Compact handles and implements offer less leverage than dedicated tools.
Blades require careful handling and may be subject to transport restrictions.
Finish and accessory bundles vary; a sheath or extra bits cannot be assumed.
useCases: Adjust a compatible fastener on non-powered equipment during kit maintenance.
Prepare packaging or cord with the correct implement, stable footing and safe hand position.
